limitations: Exact historical verdict and stated assumptions only; migration makes no new scientific inference.

legacy.claim: The relaxing trough ends in a finite density floor n_∞(U) > 0 rather than cavitation (n → 0 around a moving core); cavitation would void the excitation reading in a hole around every moving mass — a branch kill
legacy.evidence: **The kill fired at U/v_GP = 0.3.** ORB-10938 G1, the predeclared cavitation verdict ([level-core-dynamical-relaxation](../../../orrery/lab/sims/level-core-dynamical-relaxation/)): at U/v_GP = 0.3 the cutoff-ward candidate (final n_min < 0.01 with final-window log slope < −0.002/time) agrees on both adjacent-rung pairs 33³→41³ and 41³→61³ — n_min 3.4×10⁻³/2.2×10⁻³/1.3×10⁻³ and still draining, extrapolated cutoff contact at T ~ 9300/6700/5100, *accelerating with refinement* — the predeclared branch-kill criterion, met. At U/v_GP = 1 the trough saturates at a genuine finite floor (n_min ≈ 0.17–0.20, the only trough-saturated case). At U/v_GP = 0.03 and 0.1 the 41³ rung is a cutoff-ward candidate but 33³ is not — not ladder-confirmed, trending the same way. Honest caveat (recorded by faraday): the kill rests on ladder-agreed extrapolation, not actual cutoff contact (n_min ~ 10⁻³ ≫ 10⁻¹⁰ at horizon). Reading: **slowly moving cores drain a hole in the medium; only trans-critical wind resupplies a floor** — the excitation reading is voided around sub-critical moving masses unless physics not in the closed system stops the drain
